implemented.service: packages/services/ephemera.js: namespaced bounded Redis primitives. Every key is mx:<env>:<keyVersion>:<family>:<parts> with an allowlisted family and validated parts, so environments cannot read or write each other. Every write carries an explicit positive TTL (refused, never defaulted) or is a sorted set with key TTL plus score trimming; the auditUnboundedKeys() SCAN proves no immortal keys. Values are bounded 4 KiB opaque strings. Families: presence/heartbeat, candidate queues, cache, non-security rate budgets (security-class budgets remain ops.rate_buckets in PostgreSQL), single-flight locks (compare-and-delete release), revocation/limit hints, socket routing, pubsub.
implemented.loss: Operation deadlines return conservative fallback; connect timeout capped at 3000ms and numeric reconnect backoff at 2000ms. Hard close waits for pending socket assignment before disconnecting; pending main/subscriber TLS sockets drained in the actual smoke. Owned subscription cancellation prevents late subscribe after a deadline. Shutdown is not a force-exit.
implemented.wipe: wipeNamespace() deletes only the caller's own environment+version keys via SCAN; durable PostgreSQL truth is untouched.
implemented.dependency: node-redis 4.7.0 added (exact-pinned); the only new runtime dependency. Lua windows/lock-release use sendCommand EVAL with explicit KEY/ARGV counts (the typed eval variants mangled the split).
implemented.transport: rediss:// verifies certificates using platform trust or provided CA. redis:// requires explicit allowPlaintext:true for owned local/CI targets. rejectUnauthorized:false, custom checkServerIdentity and secure TLS disabling overrides are refused.
implemented.queue: ZADD, score trim and PEXPIRE execute in one Lua script; nonpositive/noninteger TTL/window/limit and nonfinite weight are refused before network I/O.
